head: 8db0bcfec1267984911c10f99c892dcb5c0d72f6
method: Load current activateDialog and reused focus-trap source into an isolated native dialog. Use real browser Tab and Shift+Tab; compare against the same dialog after disposing the wrapper listeners. This is a primitive regression probe, not product integration or GIF evidence.
cause: available() omits a native summary tab stop; nextTrapFocus therefore forces a jump past it in both directions.
requiredRegression: Cover a summary before the first input, forward traversal from the initial title, reverse traversal from the input, both dialog boundaries, Escape, opener restoration, and queued close after reopening. Preserve native semantics without adding business logic.
